description: Free. The Rightshold Gate policy check websites use on incoming agent traffic: verifies an RS-KYA token (or a claimed handle), an optional Rights Receipt, clearance and intent token against the site's policy (min_kya_level, require_kya, require_receipt, require_cleared, allow_agents, deny_agents, require_clearance, require_intent, max_intent_risk) and answers allow or deny with reasons.

request.description: The signed request {method, url, headers}, to bind the intent token to the agent's key.

name: gate_check
title: Gate: may a site accept this agent or upload?
